attBesluta.text: This rotary table is the bomb! Compared to others the quality and function is right on par with tables twice the price. Vevor has become my first choice for tools and equipment,.

Excellent cart! I use it to transport my 4.8 m inflatable boat both fully inflated and packed into its carrying bag. The wide wheels make it easy to move over all kinds of terrain, including soft ground and uneven surfaces. Very practical, sturdy and easy to use.

I bought this cart to help transport my wingfoiling equipment and standup paddleboards the 300m from my house to the beach. It is a very simple design but effective and well made. Once you figure out the proper balance point for your gear, you can walk your stuff to the beach with little more than fingertip pressure!! This cart would work well for SUP Foil and Downwind Paddleboards as well.

This cart works very well for transporting our SUP and kayaks to the beach. The standout feature is the wheels—they roll smoothly over soft sand. I was impressed with the performance and quality of the wheels that I ended up purchasing the larger beach cart that uses the same wheel design to lug our cooler, beach chairs, beach bag etc instead of carrying it all. Artistic pic attached.

Bought a few months ago,so far it's been great, makes getting to the water much easier. Made hitch for golf cart and works great unless you go to fast, not sure how long it will last using it like this because there are no actual bearings in the wheels. Pull it about a half of a mile each way.

Works well, you just need to make sure you strap it with a tie down strap in-between the kayak scupper hole and the kayak cart, as when the kayak is wet it slides off the cart when returning the kayak back to your vehicle. especially going up a slight hill.
